verdict.rationale: Sandbox testing is a fair question for an observability SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a sandbox or test environment that isolates agent or API work from production data. The API's mention of managing "environments" never says they serve as isolated test sandboxes, and the interactive demo is a product tour, not a test target. The MCP docs describe agents working against "your live Honeycomb data".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
